{{Top|leg}}
'''Burn-fungus''' was a type of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. When set on fire, it burned for around five [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and produced an faintly aromatic white smoke.
